about: Weekly live shows for the homepage 'Upcoming Event' box. Times are Mountain Time (America/Denver). When nothing is live, the box shows the flyer of the next show; a show with an empty flyer leaves the normal event card. Swap a flyer with: python3 scripts/set_flyer.py <id> <image>
